language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.
language.lessonRating: How do you feel about this exercise?

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hello, my name is Kali! I am here at the beach in the Marshall Islands with my grandson, Maru.

He really loves coming to the beach. He loves running around, climbing the rocks and trees, and playing in the water. He would love to just stay outside all day and play. He has so much energy and wants me to run around and play with him all day as well.
But, I cannot. I do not have as much energy as Maru. He is young, I am old. I used to be just as young and energetic as he is, but I grew up as time passed, I am very old now.
Did you know you are also getting older and one day, you will be old just like me! Your body will change; you will get taller, smarter and older! How much do you know about growing up?
Getting old is just part of growing up! Let's take a look at how people change throughout their lives.

Can you tell us what kind of foods are good for each person?
